content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-2|How a]]s-6|digital]] creators in regions where platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-18|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal are unavailable face a critical challenge: how to set up a functional online store. This guide addresses that by utilizing Supabase as your order database, ensuring seamless crypto payment processing. Whether you're in Nigeria, Ghana, or another restricted area, you can establish a robust digital storefront. With COREMERCH, you have the option of Stack 01 or Stack 02. This guide will specifically empower you to leverage Supabase effectively, regardless of your previous experience.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The current digital landscape is riddled with barriers for creators in many countries, where mainstream payment platforms often restrict access. COREMERCH's infrastructure provides a sovereign solution, allowing you to own your digital store completely. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages along with Supabase, you circumvent the limitations imposed by conventional payment systems. This infrastructure is designed for reliability and independence, ensuring you are not dependent on third-party services that can fail or impose fees. You gain the freedom to operate your store on your terms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before launching your digital store, gather all necessary components. Start with a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your site. Next, set up a Supabase instance for your order database. Ensure you also have a NOWPayments account ready to handle crypto transactions. Create a list of the digital products you plan to sell, and prepare their files for upload. Lastly, familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint documentation, which will guide you through the deployment process step-by-step. Preparation is key to an efficient setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Supabase database to store order information securely. Use Supabase's built-in features to create tables for transactions and customer data. Once your database is ready, integrate NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions without KYC requirements. This integration provides a seamless payment experience for your customers. Ensure that your product files are stored in a reliable location, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, enabling instant delivery upon payment confirmation. This step is crucial for maintaining customer satisfaction.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure set up, it's time to go live. Deploy your site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, making it accessible to the public. Conduct thorough testing by running a few transactions using the NOWPayments test mode. Once verified, switch to live mode to start processing real transactions. Monitor the payment status and ensure that order data is recorded correctly in Supabase. This testing phase is essential to confirm that your setup functions as expected and delivers a seamless purchasing experience for customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is operational, consider strategies for scaling. Start by analyzing sales data stored in Supabase to identify trends and customer preferences. This information can guide you in expanding your product offerings or optimizing pricing. Use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a more robust setup, which allows you to load more products and enhances your store's capabilities. Implement marketing strategies to drive traffic to your store and increase sales. Remember, continuous improvement is crucial for long-term success.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize COREMERCH's infrastructure, specifically Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 enables a swift deployment using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, taking only 4-6 hours. Stack 02 offers a more comprehensive setup with Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, deployed in 48 hours, fully tested before handoff.
Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies seamlessly.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
